# MonteFiskal

> Open-source client for Montenegro's EFI fiscalization service (Poreska uprava): .NET 10 library,
> PHP 8.5 core with the same API, WooCommerce plugin. The taxpayer supplies its own certificate and
> its own codes from the SEP portal; there is no hosted service and no shared test certificate.

Before writing integration code, ask the developer the questions in "Intake questions". Do not invent
codes, tax numbers or certificate paths. Use the test environment until the go-live checklist passes.
Montenegro's rules differ from Croatia's, Serbia's and Albania's; use the rules linked here.

## Start here

- [Briefing for assistants](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/atakancelik/MonteFiskal/main/docs/ai/context.md): everything needed for a first integration, one file
- [Intake questions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/atakancelik/MonteFiskal/main/docs/ai/questions.md): what to ask the developer first
- [Prompts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/atakancelik/MonteFiskal/main/docs/ai/prompts/README.md): ready-made tasks for .NET, PHP and WooCommerce

## Reference

- [Business rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/atakancelik/MonteFiskal/main/docs/analysis/business-rules.md): every fiscal rule with its source

- [Error codes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/atakancelik/MonteFiskal/main/docs/ai/troubleshooting.md): what each code means and what to do
- [API reference .NET](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/atakancelik/MonteFiskal/main/docs/api/dotnet.md)
- [API reference PHP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/atakancelik/MonteFiskal/main/docs/api/php.md)
- [WooCommerce setup guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/atakancelik/MonteFiskal/main/docs/setup-guide.md)
